title: 散文 5
content:
I Was Wrong
I believed
that the things that you said, they were true
That you felt for me
the way that I felt for you
I was wrong
I was wrong to believe you
wrong to have trust
wrong not to see that all you felt was lust
I was wrong
and I won't believe any more
I'm not the fool that I was before.
I believed
that heaven was there in your eyes
but I was only mislead by your lies.
I believed
that you brought my alive with your kiss
I never dreamt we'd end up like this
I was wrong
I was wrong to believe you
wrong to have trust
wrong not to see that all you felt was lust
I was wrong
but I won't believe any more
I'm not the fool that I was before.
